label: simulated from the paper’s equations (our simulation)
notes: exact free response x(t) = x0 e^{-st}(cos wd t + s/wd sin wd t), s = c/2m; no ODE solver needed
record length 10 s is our choice; the paper does not state one
AR(2) target x_{t+1} = a1 x_t + a2 x_{t-1}; exact for sampled free vibration: a1 = 2 e^{-s dt} cos(wd dt), a2 = -e^{-2 s dt}

one-head fit: x_{t+1} = wo (alpha x_t + (1 - alpha) x_{t-1}), 0 <= alpha <= 1, fixed alpha, no PE/bias (signal is zero-mean); least squares over the record. The paper’s head is data-adaptive, but its weights are still positive and sum to one at every step, so its effective coefficients always share a sign (Eq. 29)
two-head construction is ours (head A all on x_t, head B all on x_{t-1}); the paper’s trained W_O = [1.087, -1.244] (A.1) is a different solution with PE and bias
